title: jired log --field result
description: The history of the fields named with --field: one flat row per change, newest first (oldest first with --reverse), each carrying its issue, time and author

key.description: The issue asked for; null when the history covers the whole workspace

fields.description: The field names asked for, as typed; matching ignores case

total.description: How many changes matched before --limit cut them

created.description: When the change was made, UTC

field.description: The field as the changelog names it: `Sprint`, `status`, `Fix Version`

from.description: The value before; null when there was none

to.description: The value after; null when it was cleared
